title: Pāʻia Sugar Mill light industrial rezoning
summary: On September 2, 2026, the committee voted to recommend passing Bills 109 and 115 on first reading for the Pāʻia Sugar Mill redevelopment. Bill 109 would lower one 2.5-acre parcel from Heavy to Light Industrial in the community plan, and Bill 115 would rezone the land to M1. Members added conditions on water-saving practices, an evacuation route and chain businesses, and barred uses such as bed-and-breakfasts, with staff to finalize wording.
